label: Neyman allocation
subgoals: Multiply each stratum weight by its sigma
Divide each product by their sum
Scale by the total sample budget

label: Unequal simulation costs
subgoals: Divide each weight-sigma product by the square root of its cost
Normalize by the sum of weight times sigma times square root of cost

label: Sequential stopping
subgoals: Solve p times one minus p over SE squared for the total
Subtract the pilot count for the additional samples
